reply_text:
I couldn't confirm the 17 November deadline for the Halyard rollout at Marrow Agrisupply, and I've told Dana that in a thread reply in #north-team.

I only looked at what Dana can see herself: #north-team, #north-random, #general (which has no messages) and the shared files, which are the North digests and the North cheat sheet. None of them mention Marrow Agrisupply or Halyard, and I couldn't find any Marrow account files. I didn't use the cross-channel message search, because its results include conversations Dana can't see.

In the reply I said I'll treat the date as unverified and won't put it in a digest or calendar as a deadline. I asked her to post the source in the channel if someone on the account or the customer confirms it, and I'll record it then.
